author: Al Jazeera English
description:
In Mongolia’s remote Tsakhir Valley, horses mean survival. For generations, herders protected them from winter storms by gathering a vast herd and nominating their bravest young men to protect it. But mounting environmental pressures forced the centuries-old tradition to be abruptly abandoned in 2019, sparking fears that the rite of passage would be lost forever.

Determined to reclaim their heritage, village elders pledge to revive the winter herd and place the daunting responsibility on two teenage friends to safeguard the horses through what becomes Mongolia’s deadliest winter on record. Over several brutal months, the boys battle blizzards, exhaustion and doubt, discovering that in the Iron Winter, nothing can survive alone.

Iron Winter is a documentary film by Kasimir Burgess.

#aljazeeraenglish #AJWitness #Mongolia #climatechange
title: Mongolia’s Deadly Winter: Two Teenagers Fight to Save an Ancient Tradition | Witness Documentary

His comments follow a meeting with Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani in Washington, where discussions reportedly included an Iranian proposal to end the conflict.

But Iran has rejected Washington's public assessment. A senior Iranian security official has urged the US to accept Tehran's seven conditions for ending the war, including lifting sanctions, ending hostilities across the region, paying compensation and unfreezing Iranian assets.

While Trump says the US remains ready to resume military action if necessary, Tehran insists the conflict cannot be considered over while strikes and the blockade continue.

Al Jazeera's Kimberly Halkett reports from Washington, DC, and Muhammad al-Val reports from Tehran.

title: Trump says Iran war could end soon as Tehran insists on conditions
